title: Replace Formatting (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Replace Formatting applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Replace Formatting (BtnReplaceFont) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Replace Formatting matches font names case-insensitively and never reports a same-name replacement
scenarios.expected: oPenEfficiency.Core.Tests drives BulkFormatMatchPolicy for Replace Formatting: the font criterion matches a run's font name case-insensitively, a blank find or replace value matches nothing, a run with another font stays untouched, and a replacement whose name equals the run's own name is skipped as a no-op instead of becoming a change.

scenarios.title: Replace Formatting matches font sizes within the documented 0.1 pt tolerance and skips sub-0.01 pt no-ops
scenarios.expected: oPenEfficiency.Core.Tests drives BulkFormatMatchPolicy for Replace Formatting: a run within 0.1 pt of the configured find size matches (0.09 pt matches, 0.15 pt does not), a missing find or replace size matches nothing, and a replace size within 0.01 pt of the run's own size is skipped as a no-op.

scenarios.title: Replace Formatting matches colors only when equal and visible and skips same-color no-ops
scenarios.expected: oPenEfficiency.Core.Tests drives BulkFormatMatchPolicy for Replace Formatting: text, fill and line color criteria match only an exactly equal color, an invisible fill or line never matches even with an equal color, a missing find color matches nothing, and a replacement equal to the shape's or run's own color is skipped as a no-op.

scenarios.title: ReplacementScope targeting rule end-to-end on a real host
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host a three-slide presentation with one Courier New probe shape per slide is mutated by the production ReplaceFormats path with each scope in turn: CurrentSlide changes only the active slide (returns 1, slide 1 becomes Times New Roman, slides 2-3 stay Courier New); SelectedSlides with a shape selected on slide 2 follows that slide through the documented no-slide-pane-selection fallback (returns 1, only slide 2 changes); EntirePresentation walks the remaining slide (returns 1, all three probes are Times New Roman). The returned count only counts real changes, the run reports execution and writes no new %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log entry.
